monitoring.helpPre: Live readings from your PC. CPU usage comes from Windows' own counters — nothing extra installed. GPU readings come straight from your graphics driver's sensors. Frame rate &
monitoring.helpMid2: . Nothing is added to your games, and nothing is installed
monitoring.helpPost: — safe with anti-cheat. The overlay draws over borderless and windowed games (not exclusive fullscreen). Charts show the last minute.
monitoring.gpuSensorsUnavailable: GPU sensors unavailable. Compy reads these straight from your graphics driver's own sensors — installed with your NVIDIA or AMD driver, so there is nothing extra to add. This normally means the driver's sensor service isn't answering; updating or reinstalling your GPU driver is what usually brings it back. Intel GPUs don't have a panel here yet.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.help: Compy's raw view of your PC. These are the observations the recommendation engine reads to decide what to surface. If a rec you expect doesn't show up — or one you don't expect does — the answer usually lives here.
